mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits UGT1A3 and UGT1A4, reducing atazanavir glucuronidation and increasing its plasma concentrations, while atazanavir may inhibit valproic acid metabolism via CYP2C9, potentially increasing valproic acid levels.
action: Monitor atazanavir and valproic acid levels closely; consider alternative antiretroviral therapy or adjust dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring; assess for valproic acid toxicity signs including tremor, ataxia, and hepatotoxicity.
